    CDJ is a model of C_J #

    The inclusion of the intervals with index in J induces a fully faithful functor CDJ J D ⥤ CD D whose essential image is labelsIn D J = subcatJ D J, hence an equivalence CDJ J D ≌ (labelsIn D J).FullSubcategory.
